bindings.what_it_does: Translates active-runtime invocation tokens only: /skill becomes $skill, while flags, paths, branch names and prose are untouched. Canonical payloads are never rewritten.
Resolves helpers, skills and shared refs from Codex roots first, Codex home second, and Claude locations only as read-only migration inputs behind MSG_CODEX_ALLOW_CLAUDE_LEGACY=1.

Turns a canonical gate into a structured envelope with its exact decision, option set, default, owner and resume point. Answers outside the option set are rejected (exit 4), dismissal without a default is undecided (exit 5), and a surface that cannot hold the run blocks (exit 3) rather than degrading.
Writes AGENTS.md as a thin pointer to the canonical CLAUDE.md, idempotently. A human-authored AGENTS.md is never overwritten: the run stops with a conflict (exit 3), as decided for DEV-CX-004.

Generates a Codex board variant beside the byte-identical Claude board. The variant differs by exactly the declared copy substitutions plus invocation translation, and is served through server.py's existing --gui-dir/--runner seams, so the Claude experience keeps its bytes and its default runner.

Both runtimes execute the same helper implementations, so every machine emission stays byte-identical. The differential harness reruns real Claude eval fixtures against the Codex package and compares stdout, exit codes and artifact bytes.

layers.2: adapter contract, runtime bindings and write boundaries
layers.4: differential artifact parity against the existing Claude fixtures

layer3_verified: emulate-routing-and-flags: an isolated live Codex session discovers exactly the nine msg skills from .agents/skills and leaves a read-only workspace byte-identical
msg-init-cto: a live Codex session runs the Codex project init, creating the AGENTS.md pointer without modifying the canonical CLAUDE.md

honesty.why: Layers 0/2/4 run offline and prove packaging, runtime bindings, write boundaries and deterministic artifact parity for real. They do not prove that a model driving the adapter reproduces every canonical judgement — interviews, gradings, severity calls, routing choices and launch traces. 29 of the 64 cases therefore carry an explicit `residual:` line naming what is still unproven, and the runner reports runtime proof as not-run until the layer 3 suite is executed in full.
